data.long_meaning: Kewal is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'kevala', meaning 'pure', 'innocent', or 'unblemished'. This name is often used in Hindu mythology to describe individuals who possess an unblemished spirit or soul. The name Kewal carries the meaning “Pure, Innocent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kewal usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
